{{Quote|The local police enforcement agency for the Corellian cluster issued a travel warning for the city of Nashal, Talus. According to the Director of Cluster World Relations, Marx Grocco, 'Certain indigenous tribal cultures' have been very active in what has been dubbed, 'anti-human demonstrations.'|Corellia News Service|<ref name="web" />}}
'''Cluster World Relations''' was an organization of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] state tasked with promoting good relationships between the [[Human/Legends|Human]] population and tribal [[Species/Legends|species]] living on the worlds of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. Under the leadership of [[Director/Legends|Director]] [[Marx Grocco]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Cluster World Relations worked with [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Police officer/Legends|officers]] to investigate unlicensed dealings with the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==Description==
[[File:MarxGrocco.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Marx Grocco, Director of Cluster World Relations.]]
An organization of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] state, Cluster World Relations was tasked with promoting good relationships between the [[Human/Legends|Human]] population and tribal [[Species/Legends|species]] living on the worlds of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Marx Grocco]] served as [[Director/Legends|Director]] of Cluster World Relations.<ref name="web" />

==History==
{{Quote|We have no desire to cause undue panic or stress to the human citizens of Talus. This measure is meant only to insure the public safety of human travelers coming to Talus for the duration of these anti-human demonstrations.|Marx Grocco|<ref name="web" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], several [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] of the [[Neetha Den]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] were captured by [[Talusian Smugglers|pirates]] and kept as hostages in order to exploit the rest of the den.<ref name="SWG:TtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Travel to Talus|Talus}}</ref> The situation generated [[Anti-Humanism|anti-human]] sentiments among the Selonian population of Talus and hostile anti-human demonstrations erupted in the city of [[Nashal]]. Despite no act of violence against Humans was reported, the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] and Cluster World Relations issued a travel warning for Nashal. Via [[Corellia News Service]], Marx Grocco explained that this preventive measure was meant to insure the public safety of Talusian human citizens and human travelers for any possible hostile encounters with non-human protestors. During those events, Cluster World Relations worked with [[Police officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] in an investigation into any unlicensed dealings with the tribal population of Talus.<ref name="web" />
